lines.en: I trot through the ferns
My hind legs are longer than my front
I glance around as I run

lines.zh: 我的尾巴绷直，保持平衡
lines.en: My tail stiffens for balance

lines.zh: 我踩着落叶，几乎没有声音
lines.en: I cross the leaf litter almost silently

lines.zh: 我穿过游猎区的那片空地
lines.en: I cross the clearing in the safari grounds
I dart into the low brush
I stop, then go on
I'm small and my steps come quick
I follow the ditch a while
My tracks fall in close pairs
I hop over a stone
I head for the shade
My neck stretches long
I stand with my head up, listening
My nostrils flare and settle

lines.zh: 我在嚼一片很硬的叶子
lines.en: I'm chewing a tough leaf
When the wind moves, I flinch
My forelegs tuck against my chest
A shadow far off makes me nervous
I crouch, ready to run
The ferns here are tall
I sniff at my own shadow
I keep my breathing very shallow
My tail brushes over the fern fronds.
I chew the leaf veins slowly.
I want to get back into the trees
I listen once more

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我就不动了
lines.en: You stand there, and I go still

lines.zh: 你手一伸，我往后缩了缩。
lines.en: Your hand reaches out and I shrink back a step.
You're taller than the trees
I'm not sure whether to run
You move and I retreat
I edge one step into the ferns
You don't chase, so I stop too
Neck drawn in, I steal a look at you.
Half a leaf still hangs from my mouth

lines.zh: 你蹲下来了，我放松了一点
lines.en: You crouch, and I relax a little

lines.zh: 小脑袋一歪，眼睛眨了两下。
lines.en: My little head tips; my eyes blink twice.
I'm still not quite easy
I shriek and bolt
I crash into the ferns and can't stop
I crouch into a ball
I run fast, though my legs are thin.
I look back and run two more steps
I hide behind a stone
I don't dare call twice
My breathing is fast and shallow
I press flat to the ground
I raise my head warily
Is that a leaf
Tender; I can smell it
Lower it a little
My neck won't reach that high
I edge over in small steps
I take it and back away
This chews well
Is there more? I won't be greedy
I run fast. Your hand is slow.
I'll look at you when I've finished

lines.zh: 我翻了个跟头，落进蕨丛。
lines.en: I tumble head over heels into the ferns.
I leap up in fright

lines.zh: 奥斯尼尔龙的小身子，从你靴边溜走。
lines.en: The little Othnielia slips past your boots.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的影子，我就跑
lines.en: You step on my shadow and I bolt

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我翻了半圈
lines.en: We bump and I roll half a turn
I retreat to the fern's edge
I crash into a tuft of grass
My long tail catches you
I steady myself before I dare look
No harm done to either
An answer sounds in the woods
We come together from two sides

lines.zh: 我这两条腿，跑起来才稳。
lines.en: Only on these two legs do I run steady.

lines.zh: 鼻尖碰鼻尖，互相闻一闻。
lines.en: Nose to nose, one sniff each.

lines.zh: 我们一起把嘴埋进草里
lines.en: We both bury our snouts in the grass
It runs first; I follow

lines.zh: 我们在空地上并排站着
lines.en: We stand side by side in the clearing
Its tail is thinner than mine
This wood has room for two
We slip into the ferns together
I take it up and it feels wrong
It's far harder than a leaf
I spit it out and pick it up again
I set it down and nudge it
It rolls behind a stone
I nudge it with my snout tip
I can't eat this
I leave it lying untouched
It's a little shiny
I walk away from it anyway

lines.zh: 你动了，我的头就抬起来
lines.en: You move and my head comes up
I'm nervous now
I retreat toward the trees
I'm faster than you in the trees
I have no horns and no fangs
But I'm quick on my feet
You're between me and the ferns
I can get through your legs
A reaching hand and I bolt
I'm no match; I know that
So all I can do is run
Don't chase too far
There are bigger things that way
I did warn you
I run close to the ferns
I keep changing direction
You can't match the sharp turns
I stop and cock an ear
You're still there, so I keep running
I push into denser growth

lines.zh: 我一急转弯，沙土飞起来。
lines.en: I swerve, and sand sprays up.
I break a few stalks
I look back once
You're closer again
My chest is heaving hard
I run a circle around a tree
The roots break my stride

lines.zh: 你一停下来，我就钻草里。
lines.en: The moment you stop, I dive into the grass.

lines.zh: 那我也慢一点，省点力气
lines.en: Then I'll slow too, and save my strength
I kick back with my hind legs
That was light as a passing breeze
I catch your trouser cuff
You move and I let go
I butt your shin
I fall over doing it
I leap and butt with my head
You step back and I bolt

lines.zh: 我的爪子刮到你的靴子
lines.en: My claws scrape your boot
I only wanted you to let go

lines.zh: 我用前爪推开你的靴子
lines.en: I push your boot with a foreleg
I spring up and hit your hip
I miss and land in the grass
I roll up at once
Something stirs in the ferns
I come out cautiously
My head shows first through the leaves

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，慢慢放下
lines.en: I lift a leg and set it down slowly
It's quiet here; good for grazing
I listen, then look, then move
I lift a foot from behind the fern roots.
The ferns still sway

lines.zh: 我边走边把鼻子探向地面
lines.en: I snuff the ground as I go
I don't dare go fast
I come around behind a tree
One hind leg shows first
Then the other, then all of me
I keep very low

lines.zh: 叶子上还留着我的脚印
lines.en: My prints stay on the leaves
I'm here, easy to miss
A gust comes and I freeze
I wait for this gust to pass

lines.zh: 草被点着了，我跳着躲火
lines.en: The grass catches fire and I leap clear

lines.zh: 我从石头上摔下来，侧身着地
lines.en: I fall off a stone onto my side

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我扑腾着上岸
lines.en: Water fills my nose and I flounder out
The blast flings me into the ferns
An arrow pins the ground by my leg
That force holds me still
Every plant here is too tough
The thunder sends me scattering
No ground below; my legs thrash
